notes.title: Update - Version 1.6.2.0
notes.content:
Additional to yesterday’s update, which added achievements as well as applying some adjustments that may be found listed [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/346450/announcements/detail/1462969213879304760]here[/url], I’ve made a few more adjustments that may be found listed below:

- Minor adjustments to player character’s movement and combat abilities
- Minor adjustments to enemies’ AI

notes.title: Update - Version 1.5.3.6
notes.content:
This update is quite small but the changes I've made are ones that I feel are worth mentioning and are of the following:

- The player character now withstands multiple attacks that were once fatal upon one blow when playing with either the "Easy" or "Normal" difficulties selected.

- Minor tweaks with movement
